correctness.rationale: PASS. Grounding the hub gives B=[I_m;√t C] with cyclic difference C and A=I+t C^T C; P=B A^-1 B^T. The cyclic positive Green inverse has g_j=(q^j+q^(m-j))/(sqrt(1+4t)(1−q^m)). Its first differences are unimodal and the rim/rim block tCGC^T=I−G, yielding exact absolute row sums S=1+2√t(g0−g_floor(m/2)) and R=2(1−g0)+2√t(g0−g_floor(m/2)). As g0 strictly decreases from 1 to 1/m, the spoke/rim switch occurs exactly once. The hyperbolic x=m asinh((2√t)^-1) form proves finite strict ceiling <3 and matching lower/upper defect asymptotic 3−sup_t||P||=(2log m+2+o(1))/m; any optimizers satisfy x=log m+o(1), hence t~m²/(4(log m)²).
residual_risks: The optimizer t_m is not proven unique for all finite m; theorem correctly states every maximizer has the asymptotic scale for large m.
The O(m9^-m) transition remainder is derived by a local Taylor argument, not numerical evidence.
